title: DJO - DECIDE
description: Replaces Minecraft music discs with the album DECIDE by DJO, including custom titles and high-quality audio.
body:
Title: DJO - DECIDE (Music Disc Replacement)
Description
This resource pack replaces the default Minecraft music discs with tracks from the album DECIDE by DJO.

If you're a fan of Joe Keery's music, this pack is for you! It changes the audio, the names of the discs in your inventory, and the "Now Playing" messages to match the album's vibe.

Features
Custom Music: Replaces several vanilla discs with high-quality .ogg tracks.

Updated Names: All modified discs show the correct song title and artist (DJO).

Immersive: The "Now Playing" pop-up correctly displays the new song info.

Tracklist (Current)
Cat → End of Beginning

13 → Fool

Blocks → On and On

5 → Runner

Far → Bloom (More tracks coming soon!)

How to use
Download the .zip file.

Place it in your resourcepacks folder.

Activate it in-game (Options > Resource Packs).

Note: If the pack appears red (incompatible), you can still click "Yes" to activate it; it will work perfectly on version 1.21.10!

Disclaimer: All music belongs to DJO. This is a fan-made project.
